name: Instance Template
description: Per-instance-map settings: level and player limits, reset timer and the instance script. Every instanceable map should have a row here.

fields.name: Parent
fields.help: Parent map id, set only for maps nested inside another non-continent map, 0 = none.

fields.name: Level Min
fields.help: Minimum player level to enter, 0 = no limit.

fields.name: Level Max
fields.help: Maximum player level allowed to enter, 0 = no limit.

fields.name: Max Players
fields.help: Maximum number of players inside the instance, 0 = unlimited.

fields.name: Reset Delay
fields.help: Raid/heroic reset time in days, 0 = no global reset schedule.

fields.name: Script Name
fields.help: C++ InstanceData script name bound to this map.

fields.name: Mount Allowed
fields.help: Whether players can use mounts inside the instance.
